<thought>Only chlorine shows a clear M+2 peak at ~33% of the base peak, matching its characteristic isotopic pattern. No other element shows a distinctive pattern (e.g., bromine would give ~1:1 M/M+2, sulfur would give ~4% M+2). Therefore, chlorine is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['Cl']</final_answer>
